create_dataset_from_list: create a Dataset from a list of dictionaries using Dataset.from_list()
create_dataset_from_dict: create a Dataset from a dictionary of column lists using Dataset.from_dict()
test_dataset_column_names: test that a Dataset has the expected column names using column_names property
test_dataset_info_equivalence: test that Dataset.from_list and Dataset.from_dict produce equivalent dataset info
test_dataset_uneven_records: test how Dataset.from_list handles records with missing or uneven columns
